meta.name: building-inferencesh-apps
meta.description: Build and deploy applications on inference.sh. Use when getting started, understanding the platform, creating apps, configuring resources, or needing an overview of inference.sh app development. Supports both Python and Node.js. Triggers: inference.sh app, belt app, inf.yml, inference.py, inference.js, deploy app, app development, build app, create app, GPU app, VRAM, app resources, app secrets, app integrations, multi-function app

copy.tagline: 在 inference.sh 上构建和部署应用

copy.tagline_en: Build and deploy apps on inference.sh
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create and deploy apps on inference.sh

howto.what: Claude 会帮你用 Python 或 Node.js 在 inference.sh 平台上创建、测试和部署应用。它会指导你使用 belt CLI 工具，避免手动创建文件，并确保代码结构正确。
howto.when: 当你提到“inference.sh 应用”、“部署应用”、“创建应用”等关键词，或者询问如何开始使用 inference.sh 平台时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 inference.sh 应用，用 Python。
如何在应用中添加 GPU 资源？

howto.what_en: Claude helps you create, test, and deploy apps on inference.sh using Python or Node.js. It guides you through using the belt CLI, avoiding manual file creation, and ensuring correct code structure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'inference.sh app', 'deploy app', 'create app', or ask about getting started with the inference.sh platform.

say_en.text: Create an inference.sh app using Python.
say_en.note: Claude will run belt app init and generate the project structure.

say_en.text: Deploy my app and test it.
say_en.note: Claude will execute belt app deploy and belt app run.

say_en.text: How do I add GPU resources to my app?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to modify the resources.gpu section in inf.yml.
